visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men sit in a vibrant pink-themed retail store. One man wears a pink knit cardigan over a white shirt, gesturing expressively while speaking to the other man in a white graphic t-shirt. The background is filled with pink architectural arches and cosmetic displays. (2) A close-up shows the man in the white t-shirt applying a liquid cosmetic to his cheek using a black sponge. The man in the pink cardigan holds a black product bottle with neon green text. Large yellow variety text overlays the bottom of the screen. (3) The man in the pink cardigan demonstrates a pink cushion compact by submerging it in a white bowl of water. He holds a clear glass beaker with powder inside, showing its waterproof properties. The lighting is bright and even throughout the scene. (4) The man in the pink cardigan holds an orange spray bottle and sprays it into his open mouth. The host reacts with a wide-eyed, shocked facial expression. The man then gestures with the bottle toward the camera as they continue their dialogue. (5) A montage shows various products, including circular powder compacts and spray bottles, displayed on pink shelves. The host is seen holding a microphone with a yellow and blue logo, smiling at the camera as the video concludes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and energetic electronic BGM starts immediately. A male voice (host) begins speaking with high energy and a friendly tone. A 'pop' SFX is heard as the first text overlay appears. (2) A 'ding' SFX signals a product highlight as the main guest explains the foundation. The BGM remains steady with a prominent synth bassline. (3) A clear 'splash' and 'liquid' SFX occur as the cushion compact is dipped into water. The male voices exhibit high arousal and excitement. (4) A sharp 'pop' and 'cartoon whoosh' SFX transition into a new scene. The BGM maintains its moderate tempo. (5) A distinct 'hiss' SFX from a spray bottle is heard, followed by a loud, comical shout from the host. The audio track is dense with overlapping speech and music. (6) A final 'whoosh' leads to a narration segment. A third male voice delivers a clear, professional promotional message. The BGM reaches its peak energy before a sharp cut-off.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature Demo -> Emotional Reaction -> CTA/Information
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the brand Vincent's World and its new store opening in Tainan Eslite. The video uses humorous demonstrations of product durability (waterproof) and safety (edible mist) to build consumer trust and excitement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of products, presence of brand founder, and final promotional discount information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A fast-paced social media advertisement blending comedy vlog style with professional beauty product demonstrations.
